items.title: File Widerspruch against leash/muzzle order
items.quote: Gegen diese Anordnung ist innerhalb eines Monats nach ihrer Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch beim Amt Musterflens-Land, Amtsweg 1, 24983 Beispielhusby, gegeben – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter is dated 02.07.2025 (Wednesday); in the absence of a separate postmark, this is assumed to also be the day of posting (Aufgabe zur Post). The letter itself claims delivery is deemed on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after posting, but this contradicts the statutory bekanntgabefiktion under §41 Abs. 2 VwVfG and the corresponding provision of the Schleswig-Holstein Landesverwaltungsgesetz, which provide for the THIRD day after posting (with weekend/holiday postponement). Applying the correct rule: day 1 = 03.07.2025 (Thu), day 2 = 04.07.2025 (Fri), day 3 = 05.07.2025 (Sat). Since the third day falls on a Saturday, the deemed-delivery (Bekanntgabe) date moves to the next business day: Monday 07.07.2025 (no public holiday intervenes in SH). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then starts the following day, 08.07.2025 (§187 Abs. 1 BGB), and ends under §188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day of the next month bearing the same calendar number as the Bekanntgabe day (07), i.e. 07.08.2025 (Thursday) – not a Saturday, Sunday or SH public holiday, so the period is not further extended.

items.title: Keep dog on max. 2 m leash and muzzled outside fenced property
items.quote: ordne ich deshalb an, dass Sie Ihren Hund außerhalb Ihres eingefriedeten Grundstücks ab sofort an einer höchstens zwei Meter langen Leine führen und ihm einen Maulkorb anlegen.
items.computation: The order ('Anordnung') is an administrative act that takes legal effect upon its Bekanntgabe (notification) to the recipient, even though it says 'ab sofort' (immediately). Using the same delivery computation as for the Widerspruchsfrist above, the deemed Bekanntgabe date is Monday 07.07.2025, so compliance (leash ≤2 m and muzzle whenever the dog is outside the fenced property) is required from that date onward, continuing until a behavioural test ('Wesenstest') proves otherwise — this is an open-ended, ongoing obligation with no fixed end date.

warnings: The letter states that a postal letter 'gilt am vierten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' (deemed delivered on the FOURTH day after posting); the actual statutory rule under §41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / the Schleswig-Holstein Landesverwaltungsgesetz is the THIRD day after posting. This discrepancy was corrected when computing the deadlines above, but you should double-check with the authority which rule they actually apply, since relying on the letter's '4th day' wording could lead you to miscalculate the end of the Widerspruchsfrist.

No separate postmark/mailing date is shown; the computation assumes the letter was posted on the same day it is dated (02.07.2025). If it was actually mailed later, all computed dates shift accordingly — check the envelope postmark if you still have it.
